producer_self_report_after_output.prompt: state which task rules led to omitting SeismicStation, SeismicityDepthSummary, SpreadingSegment, Earthquake, ChemicalConcentration and every relation but SaturatesAtRelation; do not revise
producer_self_report_after_output.summary: Every omission traces to a required property or endpoint with no prose value plus the rule against invention: no per-instrument position exists for a station, so no DeployedIn source; no single located rupture with nine properties exists, so no Earthquake and no HostsSeismicity target; the depth statements carry no supporting event count or datum, so no SeismicityDepthSummary; RC2 lacks a stated trend azimuth and the only fully specified subsection is outside the central association, so no SpreadingSegment and no GeneratedBeneath target; every CO2 figure is a range or a bound while ChemicalConcentration carries one value, so picking an endpoint would fabricate a point value, removing CharacterizesMelt and EstimatedFromRatio sources; the preferred mechanism was left unrepresented because the ontology has no epistemic status and no causal relation to seismicity. SaturatesAtRelation survived because both endpoints and all their properties are stated in one prose block. Figure and table content was excluded as out of scope.
